Tessa —

Appreciate the invite and the SOW. Quick update from our side: we just concluded a product leadership sprint and leadership has re-prioritized near-term roadmap work. The inference pilot you and Aditya discussed has been deprioritized for this quarter while we focus on a platform stability sprint.

Two practical constraints: our Head of AI (who would be the technical reviewer) is traveling and unavailable until after Nov 20, and our engineering squad has been reassigned to a high-priority bug block until the end of the quarter. Given that, we’ll need to pause/demo defer for now — I’m sorry for the short notice.

Can we do the following?
- Pause the demo sequence for November and re-evaluate in early Jan (the first week preferred).
- Keep the SOW on file; our procurement contact (procurement@clearwave.com) can review but won’t be signing until the program is active again.

I’ll follow up with a concrete date availability in December but realistically expect a Jan kick. If you have any lightweight materials or a 10–15 minute pre-read for stakeholders who won’t be available later, feel free to send them.

Thanks,
Evan Turner
Director, Product Strategy | ClearWave
E: evan.turner@clearwave.com

Subject: FW: ClearWave — pause requested during sprint reorg

Aditya / Grace — forwarding Evan's note. Short summary: ClearWave is asking to defer the Nov 12 demo due to a leadership reprioritization and travel (Head of AI out until Nov 20). They want to revisit in early Jan.

Proposed playbook options (please weigh in):
1) Low-touch pause: Acknowledge, archive the SOW, set a follow-up reminder for Jan 8 in HubSpot. Share a one-pager and a short pre-recorded 10m demo that stakeholders can watch asynchronously. No credits offered now.
2) Maintain engagement: Offer a 2-hour office-hour session for their Head of AI once they return (target week of Nov 23) — low lift but keeps momentum.
3) Incentive route: Offer a $5k pilot credit or a 30-day extended trial window if they commit to a Q1 pilot by a target date.

Risks: if we ghost, they'll go cold; if we push too hard we create procurement headaches. My leaning: option 1 + a one-pager and a scheduled Jan follow-up. If Aditya thinks the account has expansion potential we could escalate option 3 to sales leadership.

Actions: Aditya — want to weigh in on whether to surface a pilot credit? Grace — can you prepare a 10m recorded demo + 1-pager we can send? I’ll reply to Evan to acknowledge and propose the Jan follow-up.

Thanks,
Tessa

Thanks for the context and for flagging the availability constraints. Totally understand — roadmap shifts happen. We’ll pause the Nov 12 slot and keep the SOW on file.

Two small things while we’re paused that might be helpful without adding to your sprint load:

- We’ll set a calendar check-in for the week of Jan 4–8 to re-evaluate timelines; I’ll drop a tentative follow-up into HubSpot and we can firm the date in December.

If anything changes before then (e.g., your Head of AI returns earlier or a slot opens up), please let me know — we can do a short working session instead of a full demo.

Appreciate the heads-up, and we’ll stay low-touch until Jan.
